title: Full Stack Developer Portfolio with Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, and Server Actions
transcript:
Building a production portfolio in Next.js 15:
Use Next.js 15 App Router with Server Components for all static content. This guarantees zero client-side JavaScript overhead for reading project descriptions.
Only use Client Components ('use client') for interactive widgets: the theme toggle, the contact form with Server Actions, and the canvas animation.
Use Tailwind CSS v4 for rapid utility styling with custom design tokens.
Set up metadata and OpenGraph images dynamically using next/og so when you share your portfolio link on LinkedIn or Twitter, it renders a gorgeous social preview card with your name and photo.
